# rubix

> A dependency-free Go Rubik's cube library and solver CLI: model the cube as data, apply moves, parse facelet strings and notation, and solve it with several strategies.

The cube library is importable as `github.com/danielriddell21/rubix/pkg/cube`. It has no external dependencies. The `rubix` command (`cmd/rubix`) exposes solving, scrambling, verification, and an optional self-driving visualizer (`-tags ebiten`).

Core library API:

```go
type Cube struct{ /* ... */ }

func Solved() Cube
func FromFacelets(f Facelets) (Cube, error)
func ParseFacelets(s string) (Facelets, error)
func (c Cube) Applied(ms ...Move) Cube
func (c Cube) IsSolved() bool

type Move uint8
func ParseMoves(s string) ([]Move, error)
func InverseSeq(ms []Move) []Move
```

Solvers live in `internal/solver` and are selected by name on the CLI (`rubix solve --strategy <name>`; `rubix solvers` lists them). A cube can be built from a 54-character facelet string (URFDLB) or scanned from a LEGO EV3 robot.

## Docs
